safeguards: Ranking outcomes are validation-only and must never be added to V2 model components or fitting targets.
Thresholds are fixed before reading the review decision output and must not be retuned merely to obtain a pass.
A supportive outcome decision does not authorize canonical country-rating authoring.
Senior national-team ranking is an indirect outcome for domestic competition quality and must be combined with domestic/context evidence before canonical promotion.
San Marino remains a valid held-out outcome with a missing V2 competition score and is excluded from numeric threshold counts rather than treated as zero.
